proposals.description: Incomplete fact extraction in MCP intent classification causing data loss
proposals.rationale: The system is failing to extract complete facts from user inputs, as evidenced by 'extracted_value: report' vs 'expected_value: report' where the full context is missing, leading to potential loss of critical information needed for proper intent classification.
proposals.proposed_action: Implement comprehensive fact extraction logic that captures complete user intent and context, not just partial matches

proposals.description: Inconsistent entity extraction in MCP entity correctness analysis
proposals.rationale: The entity extraction is producing inconsistent results with missing or incomplete data, as shown by the evidence referencing 'de_mod_pipeline.py' which suggests a core module failure in entity processing.
proposals.proposed_action: Review and fix the entity extraction logic in 'de_mod_pipeline.py' to ensure consistent and complete entity identification

proposals.description: Incomplete extraction coverage for short user turns
proposals.rationale: Short user inputs like '1+1 답만 해줘' are not being fully covered by extraction logic, indicating a gap in handling concise user queries that could lead to reduced system effectiveness.
proposals.proposed_action: Enhance extraction coverage logic to handle short-turn scenarios and ensure all user inputs are properly processed regardless of length

proposals.description: Missing or incomplete intent classification for greeting tags
proposals.rationale: The greeting tag extraction appears to be incomplete or missing, which could affect proper conversation flow and user experience when handling initial user interactions.
proposals.proposed_action: Review the MCP tag extraction logic to ensure all relevant tags including greetings are properly identified and classified

proposals.description: Partial fact extraction in short user turn scenarios
proposals.rationale: The extraction completeness issue in short turns suggests that the system may miss important details when processing brief user inputs, potentially affecting accuracy.
proposals.proposed_action: Implement more robust extraction logic that can handle both long and short user inputs with equal effectiveness

proposals.description: Inconsistent intent classification results across similar user inputs
proposals.rationale: The high severity inconsistencies in intent classification suggest that the system's decision-making process may be unstable or overly sensitive to minor variations in input.
proposals.proposed_action: Implement more stable intent classification algorithms and add consistency checks to ensure reproducible results across similar inputs

proposals.description: Operational metrics (timing, tokens) are not recorded in review_facts
proposals.rationale: This prevents monitoring and optimization of the extraction pipeline's performance and resource usage
proposals.proposed_action: Modify review_facts function in extract_pipeline.py to capture and log timing and token usage from LLM responses

proposals.description: Activity log body lacks faithfulness scores, retry history, and unfaithful fact lists
proposals.rationale: This breaks traceability and debugging capabilities for extraction failures and retry mechanisms
proposals.proposed_action: Update activity_log body construction in extract_pipeline.py to include faithfulness metrics, retry counts, and unfaithful fact details

proposals.description: review_facts.verdict remains 'pending' and is never updated downstream
proposals.rationale: This prevents proper state management and downstream processing of extraction results
proposals.proposed_action: Implement UPDATE logic in downstream pipeline components to set review_facts.verdict to appropriate values (e.g., 'pass', 'fail', 'retry')

proposals.description: LLM client does not extract token usage and timing from API responses
proposals.rationale: Missing this data prevents performance monitoring and cost optimization for LLM calls
proposals.proposed_action: Modify lib/llm_client.py to parse and extract token usage and timing information from /v1/completions API responses
